Ṛju
a. of a C. on Manusmṛti. Q. by Medhātithi on Manu
. C.. Ṛjavah2 q. by Rāmanātha in his Dāyabhāgaviveka (C..

Ṛjutvacandrodaya
by Cochi Raṅgappācārya (1820 -91), son of Śrīnivāsācārya of Coimbatore, on the claims of Vādirāja to Ṛjutva. See J. Myth. Soc. XXIX. p. 448.

Ṛjupāṭha
in 3 Pt.. Sanskrit lessons compiled by Īśvaracandravidyāsāgara; with English an. Bengali translations by Śyāmacaraṇa Chatterjee. Pt.. Calcutta, 1880. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 412.
--C. (Key). Pt.. Calcutta, 1879. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 412.

Ṛjuprakāśikā
name of Akhaṇḍānanda Sarasvatī's C. on Vācaspati's Bhāmatī on the Brahmasūtrabhāṣya of Śaṅkara.

Ṛjubhāṣya
one of the names of Vijñānabhikṣu's C. on the Brahmasūtra.

Ṛjubhāṣya
name of a.. Bhāṣya on Vājasaneyisaṁhitā (CLB. I. p. 15) (resembles partially Uvaṭa's C.).

Ṛjumitākṣarā
the complete name of the Mitākṣarā by Vijñāneśvara, on the Yājñavalkya Smṛti.

Ṛjuladhvī(mālatīmādhavakathā)
in verse form, by Pūrṇasarasvatī.

Ṛjuvimarśinī
C. on a. Āgama text; Kās. Śai. by the Paramaguru of Maheśvarānanda. Q. in latter's Mahārthamañjarī,

Ṛjuvimarśinī
name of C. by Śivānanda on the Catuśśatī (Nityāṣoḍaśikārṇava).

Ṛjuvimalā
name of C. by Gopālamiśra on Āpast. gṛh. sūtra. Baroda 9802. See NCC. II. p. 127a.

Ṛjuvimalā_Pañcikā
name of Śālikanātha's C. on Bṛhatī of Prabhākara. See edn. in Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser.

Ṛjuvivaraṇa
name of C. on Prakāśātman's Pañcapādikāvivaraṇa by Viṣṇubhaṭṭopādhyāya, son of Janārdana an. disciple of Svāmīndrapūrṇa.
. Included in the edn. of Brahmasūtras with Śaṅkarabhāṣya an. nine C.s, Cal. Skt.

Ṛjuvṛtti
name of C. by Narasiṁhasūri on the Kārikās of Kāvyaprakāśa.

Ṛjuvyākhyā
Pt. III. by Rāmagati Nyāyaratna. Calcutta, 1869 (3rd edn.). See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897.

Ṛjusārasvataprakriyā
gr. by Anubhūtisvarūpa. D. p. 383 (2 mss.). See under Sārasvatavyākaraṇa.
